title: Deploy gate (warn-only): surface error budget burn in CI/CD + Slack notify
author: Jordan Lee
release_notes: Internal: CI/CD now emits a warn-only deploy gate signal when a target tier is burning/exhausting error budget; warnings are posted to Slack and overrides are logged for auditability.
description: Context: As part of the tiered SLO + error budget enforcement rollout (Q1 2026), we need an initial “warn-only” phase that makes error budget state visible at deploy-time without blocking critical fixes. This PR adds a deploy gate step to our CI/CD pipeline that queries the current error budget state for the target tier/region, posts a warning to Slack when a tier is in a red/burning state, and logs any operator override intent (even though warn-only does not block). Scope: Hosted + Dedicated tiers; prod deploys only; Private out of scope. Behavior: (1) Determine deploy context (tier, region, env) from the deployment manifest and pipeline metadata. (2) Fetch error budget status from the SLO service (slo-control-plane) using the new `/v1/error-budget/state` endpoint (rolling 30d window, plus burn-rate annotations). (3) If state is `burning` or `exhausted`, emit a CI annotation + Slack notification with links to dashboards and the mitigation runbook. (4) If the operator provides `--override-error-budget` (or sets `ERROR_BUDGET_OVERRIDE=1`), record the override reason/link (incident URL or Linear key) to the deploy event log and emit `deploy_gate_overrides_total{tier,region,service}` for later review. (5) If the SLO service is unavailable or returns an unknown state, do NOT fail the pipeline; instead warn with a “data unavailable” message and include troubleshooting links. Implementation details: Introduces `tools/deploy-gate` (Go) used by Buildkite step `deploy_gate_error_budget_warn_only`. Adds a small shared client in `pkg/slo_client` with conservative timeouts/retries and a circuit breaker to avoid compounding an outage. Adds structured logging fields (`tier`, `region`, `service`, `budget_state`, `budget_remaining`, `burn_rate_short`, `burn_rate_long`, `override_present`, `override_reason`). Adds Slack notifier integration via existing `pkg/notify/slack` (same path used by incident-bot) and posts to `#eng-sre` and `#release-ops` for prod, with thread key `{service}:{tier}:{region}:{deploy_id}` to keep messages grouped. Links: Runbook: Confluence “Error budget breach mitigation runbook”; Policy: Confluence “Error budget policy and enforcement”; Dashboards: “Tiered SLO dashboards and annotations”. Follow-ups: This does NOT block deploys yet. Enforcement and policy tightening is tracked in ENG-4941. Notes on safety: Gate is guarded behind `deploy_gate.error_budget.enabled` (default on for prod, warn-only). Unknown/missing data never blocks in this phase. Cardinality: override metric does not include customer/model labels (only tier/region/service).

review_thread: Aisha Bello: Can we confirm this does not block deploys in any scenario, including when the SLO service is down? Also please ensure the warning links the mitigation runbook + tiered dashboard view.

Jordan Lee: Confirmed: warn-only in all cases. Unknown/unavailable state emits a warning annotation + Slack message but exits 0. Added explicit messaging + links to runbook and the tiered SLO dashboard landing page.
Connor O'Brien: Please scope this to prod deploys only for now. Staging is too noisy and will desensitize folks. Also, don’t post to broad channels for non-prod.
Jordan Lee: Updated Buildkite step to only run for prod env. Slack notifier now only posts for prod; non-prod remains CI annotation only (still exit 0).
Sahana Iyer: Slack webhook handling: ensure we’re using existing secret references and not introducing a new one. Also please redact tokens/URLs from logs.
Jordan Lee: Reused `SLACK_NOTIFIER_WEBHOOK_URL` secret already present in release pipelines. Added log redaction (we only log channel + message id). No webhook URL logged.
Rafael Mendes: Override logging: what’s the expected format for the override reason? We’ll want to audit why people override frequently.

Jordan Lee: Added doc + validation: override requires either `INCIDENT_URL` or `LINEAR_KEY` format (best-effort in warn-only; validation becomes strict in enforcement phase). Also emitting `deploy_gate_overrides_total` for tracking.
Logan Wright: Please ensure we don’t add customer/model labels in any emitted metrics (cardinality risk).
